book.name: Jeims
book.title: Jeims na letama tauwai sumaḡa matabudi ḡarodie

content: Mamaitua na waibadama dibune ko miana

Taumi koya kataie bo ibewa, da aba aubainama kowai kawa riuriu be kowai kawa ḡasiḡasi? Inam waikawa ḡasiḡasidima ta tubutubuḡana, baninama tubuḡa na ḡoana be noḡota veredima nopomie tawai ḡaviḡaviana.

Taumi ami ḡoanama yabedima kadi taiye banaga kowai guridi, be yaḡoro inam yabedima tokare nam ko ragaragaudi. Taumi banaga adi purapurama ko kitedi, be ko unuunuredina. Vutuna aubainama taumi ami banagama mate kowai kawa riuriu be kowai kawa ḡasiḡasina, be yaḡoro inam yabedima tokare nam ko ragaragaudi. Be aba aubainama inam yabedima nam koma ragaragau? Inam baninama, taumi Mamaitua nam komawai baḡana aubainama.

Be deḡoda Mamaitua kowai baḡa be ami ḡoanama nam e utemi, inam baninama taumi ami noḡotama gewegewedie Mamaitua kowai baḡana. Taumi Mamaitua kowai baḡana da tauna ami ḡoanama kabe e utemi, be inam yabedima yawasana wainua vaivaidie kabe koi yakaredi, inam nam i verena.

Taumi aitauḡa Mamaitua ko tuatuaḡaiena, taumi inam waivi na tauḡomama mui debane e poreporena maika. Aba aubainama taumi dobu na ḡoanama kowai muriwatane? Koya kataie bo ibewa, deḡoda dobu yawasanidima koi nuapaḡoedina, taumi inam Mamaitua ko tuatuaḡaiena. Deḡoda taumi dobu yawasanidima koi turanedina, taumi inam Mamaitua na ḡaviama.

Girugiruminama porane aba ya riuriuena inam giu kavakavana, bo? Girugiruminama porane umanama ya riuna, “Mamaitua Aruinama ya uteda be nopode e miamiana, be tauna inam Aruinama debane dobu yawasanidima e koukouburuedina.”
Be Mamaitua raukivivere baneginama aubainama girugiruminama porane umanama ya riuna,

content.text: “Mamaitua banaga rarauguyaguyaudima e biri dobiḡedina, be e raukiviverena voyaḡota banegidima ḡarodie.”

content: Vutuna aubainama Mamaitua na waibadama dibune ko miana, be Diaboro ko riutuaḡaie da tauna e gosemi be naira e naḡona.

Taumi ko verauna Mamaitua diane, yodibe Mamaitua e verauna taumi diemie. Taumi gewagewa banegimima, nopomima ko koḡa be ko kawa veremina, maika nema nimemima ko koḡakoḡana nama, be nam noporaburabui nopomie e kena.
Ami gewagewama aubainama koi nuaboya be ko ḡabana. Koya kwatekwatevana, yodi ko gose be ko ḡabana. Koyawai nuaverena, yodi ko gose be koi nuaboyana.
Bada matane ko ḡaubo munaḡa, be tauna e kawa saḡemina.

Yau bana, ami banagama nam koi karakara kutuedi bo koi tara piriedi. Deḡoda tam aitau turamma kwai tara piriena, tam inam Mamaitua na tarawatuma kwawai diboḡina. Tam Mamaitua na tarawatuma nam sibo kuyai tara pirie, avedi! Tam sibo tarawatu kuya voteyeteyena.

Tauwai tarapiri inam Mamaitua taunaḡa, nam tam. Tauna vutuna tarawatu ya utedana, aubainama tauna taunaḡa na ḡoane nama tokare banaga ei yawasanidi bo e kawa gewegewedi, inam taunaḡa ewai badena. Tam nema maika kitam, be turamma kwawai tarapirie, wa?
Taumi aitauḡa umanama ko giugiuna, “Tauda manaka bo pomai tà naḡo taonie da modi tenaḡa tà mia be tài bisnis da mane dosinama tà voiena.” Inam nama banegimima ami giuma yodi yà riuemi be ko vaiena.
Taumi nam ko kataiena da aba mateḡa bo pomai e tubuḡa. Taumi ami yawasanama inam kai basunama maika, yodi raḡan ḡaubonaḡa ko kitana, be murine ei kave munaḡana.
Vutuna aubainama taumi sibo umanama koya riuriuna, “Deḡoda Bada e ḡoena, naumeki da tauda tà mia be umanama umanama yabedima tà voiedina.”
Taumi ko rarau guyaguya be ko seḡaseḡarana. Inam kauinama ko gose pore. Seḡara dokadoka inam yaba gewagewanama.
Taumi deḡoda vere koya kataiena be nam ko voie, inam tauna gewagewa.
